field_audit.data: author's own Claude Code sessions, aggregate only
field_audit.caveat: Text checks. 'Not mentioned in the summary' is not the same as 'mattered'. Precision was not hand-labelled.
field_audit.measured_with: v0.1.0 (0.1.1 changes presentation only; --json, --hook and plain output are byte-identical on the test fixture)

regression_check_0.1.3.data: author's own Claude Code sessions, a frozen copy of the 31 transcripts with a compaction
regression_check_0.1.3.result: --hook output (per transcript) byte-identical to v0.1.2; --all --json summary identical; the only label difference is one instruction whose emoji lost U+FE0F (variation selectors are now stripped)
regression_check_0.1.3.redaction_equivalence: redact_assignments() and redact_mysql() matched the 0.1.2 regexes on 300,000 random strings (seed 7) and 4,000 in the unit test

security.reviewer: PASS (security-reviewer re-run on 0.1.3 twice: the first pass confirmed the nine 0.1.2 findings fixed and raised five lows, fixed above as 're-review'; the second pass found none)
findings_fixed: file and todo labels redacted and collapsed to one line
credential patterns: URL userinfo, password/token/key assignments, bearer, mysql -p, private key headers, slack and google keys
hook output framed as a data block, JSON-quoted items, no rules injected
hook never fails the session on bad input

docker regex: the space-separated option argument was dropped in 0.1.0. This entry used to say 'without nested ambiguous quantifier', which was wrong: the option token --?[\w-]+ could split '--a' two ways, so the pattern still backtracked exponentially (0.19 s at 20 options, about 4x per 2 more). Found in the 0.1.2 review, fixed in 0.1.3 (see below).

0.1.1: control and format characters (ESC, BEL, C0/C1, bidi, zero-width) stripped from every transcript-derived field before printing: labels, compaction timestamp and trigger, session file and project folder names
0.1.1: non-integer token counts and odd metadata no longer raise during --all
0.1.1: FORCE_COLOR=0/false no longer forces the board; SKILL.md lists the display variables it reads
0.1.2: an unreadable session path prints one sanitised stderr line instead of a traceback; --since alone is a usage error; --json prints valid JSON when nothing is found

0.1.3: --json output runs session paths, labels and failing test commands through the same printable() as the text receipt (C1 CSI/OSC, ESC, BEL, bidi, zero-width and tag characters no longer reach stdout or come back under jq -r)
0.1.3: printable() turns U+2028/U+2029 into spaces and drops lone surrogates and invisible Mn/Lo characters (variation selectors U+FE00-FE0F and U+E0100-E01EF, U+034F, Hangul fillers)

0.1.3: docker option token made unambiguous (--?[A-Za-z0-9][\w-]*), command splitting and credential-assignment redaction made linear; shlex runs only on segments naming an ssh-family tool, on their first 4 KB; Bash commands and user messages cut to 64 KB and paths, todos and test commands to 4 KB before scanning; timing regression tests (200 docker options well under 1 s)
0.1.3: odd record shapes are skipped, any other per-file error prints 'cannot parse <path>: <type>' and the run goes on with valid --json; find_sessions skips dangling symlinks
0.1.3: hook_context() applies printable() to labels injected into model context
0.1.3: plain receipt names the project folder; SKILL.md says --latest spans all projects and passes the current transcript for this session
0.1.3: SKILL.md runs the script by its absolute path everywhere
0.1.3: disclosure lists HOME and LINES; it says the cleaning covers plain, board, --json and --hook output; the --json note mentions the --all summary
0.1.3: test fixtures build credential-shaped strings at runtime
0.1.3 re-review: transcript text is cleaned with printable() before redact(), so control or zero-width characters cannot split a credential past the patterns
0.1.3 re-review: the mysql -p redaction is a linear scan with the same matches as the 0.1.2 regex (it was quadratic on repeated 'mysql')
0.1.3 re-review: user messages are cut to 64 KB before rule extraction, which also bounds the _rule_labels cache
0.1.3 re-review: SKILL.md says --latest takes the most recently modified session that has a compaction
notes_for_0.1.4: Mongolian variation selectors U+180B-U+180D and U+180F (Mn) are not stripped; they carry at most 4 values each
RULE_RE runs on the raw sentence, so a zero-width character inside 'never' can keep a rule from being nominated (detection only)
file fact keys keep the raw path, so two paths that differ only by invisible characters print as two items with the same label
